headline: Axios reports that suspected bots wrote about a third of the conspiracy posts during the Workday outage; the cause is unchanged.
summary: Added s017, a Nov 19 Axios report (Tier 2) citing PeakMetrics data: suspected bots accounted for 34% of conspiracy-related posts during the Workday outage, versus 27% of other posts, and Axios says there is no publicly established evidence of a coordinated cyberattack. Added c011 as Reported (one outlet relaying one firm's analysis) and linked it to q002. No label change on q001, which stays Not established. Checked, not found: a Workday root-cause report, an SEC 8-K about the outage (latest 8-K Oct 23), a CISA or regulator statement naming Workday. Staleness check done on the head. headline: Workday's statement that the outage was not a security incident is now Confirmed as its own words; a hack is still not ruled out.
summary: Added s016, a Nov 18 USA TODAY report in which Workday confirmed the outage was not a security incident and said there is no indication it is connected to other recent outages. With WUSA9 (s005) that is two independent outlets with their own sourcing, so c002 moves from Reported to Confirmed. This confirms that Workday made the denial, not that the denial is true; q001 stays Not established.
